concerns: Plan/allowed-files deviation: commit T7 (b3f5cf8) re-touches src/main/java/com/example/shortener/codegen/RedisBatchCounterSource.java, codegen/ShortCodeAllocator.java and read/RedisUrlCache.java, which are not in T7's allowed_files (T7 is limited to openapi.yaml and the it/ test package). These late production-code edits to the counter/cache internals need an explicit justification and a check that T4/T6 unit tests were updated accordingly, otherwise the governed file-scope contract is broken.

AC-16 edge case: 404s produced because a controller is not registered under the 'read'/'write' profile are served by Spring's default no-handler path and are likely text/plain or the default error body rather than application/problem+json. Confirm ProfileSeparationIT asserts only status and that the spec's 'every error response is problem+json' intent is either met (throw-exception-if-no-handler-found + advice) or documented as an accepted exception.

AC-10 cross-instance uniqueness is asserted only by an in-process concurrency test (RedisBatchCounterSourceTest) plus reasoning about the shared Redis key; there is no test that runs two allocator instances against the same Testcontainers Redis to prove non-overlapping batches.

Ambiguities AMB-9 (24h default cache TTL), AMB-10 (gaps accepted on restart) and AMB-11 (counter seed so codes are >= 3 chars) remain open in the spec and were implemented at their defaults. They are documented in docs/operations.md/README, but they still require explicit human confirmation rather than being treated as settled.

Malformed ISO-8601 expiration_date cannot be covered by CreateUrlRequestValidationTest (it fails during Jackson deserialization, not validation). Verify the malformed case is actually asserted in GlobalExceptionHandlerTest/CreateShortUrlIT rather than only the past-date case.

Unverifiable from the changeset alone: no gate/test execution output was supplied (./mvnw test, -Pit verify, ArchitectureTest, spotless:check). All verdicts above rest on the presence of the named files/tests and the plan DoD, not on observed green runs.

Security/PII: no auth is in scope (per non-goals) and created_by is left null, which is correct; however GET /{short_code} and POST bodies contain user-supplied URLs - confirm the degradation/error logs in RedisUrlCache, ShortCodeAllocator and GlobalExceptionHandler do not log full long_url values or Redis/DB connection strings.

Scope: docs/operations.md and .github/workflows/ci.yml are beyond the spec deliverable list (Dockerfile, README, OpenAPI, tests). They are plan-sanctioned (T8) and low risk, but are additive scope relative to the spec.
